plainTranslation: Their Sun in your 12th house: a connection that feels charged and half-hidden - they touch the part of you that runs below awareness. Often surfaces in dreams. Failure mode: a relationship lived in secret or in your head, never brought into daylight. Bring it into the open, or understand why you can't.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
